chunks: And from him, from Muhassan ibn Ahmad, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who performs an Umrah al-Mufradah (independent Umrah); from where does he terminate the Talbiyah? He said: When you see the houses of Dhi Tuwa, then terminate the Talbiyah.

key_terms.التَّلبِيَة: The ritual proclamation of 'Labbayk' during Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.ذِي طُوًي: Dhi Tuwa, a place near Mecca where the Talbiyah is terminated
key_terms.عُمۡرَة مُفۡرَدَة: Independent Umrah (Umrah performed separately from Hajj)

ai.seo_question: Where does a pilgrim stop reciting the Talbiyah when performing independent Umrah?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) provides the precise geographical marker for terminating the Talbiyah during Umrah al-Mufradah, specifying the sighting of the houses of Dhi Tuwa. This ruling highlights the Shia emphasis on specific locational boundaries (Miqaat) for ritual transitions, distinguishing the entry into the state of Ihram for Umrah from that of Hajj. It serves as a practical legal guideline for pilgrims to ensure the correctness of their ritual declarations at the designated threshold of the sacred precincts.
